import json, os

v1 = json.load(open('/root/autodl-tmp/contrastive_trace_safety/artifacts/exp_r3_r1_32b_layer63_bootstrap/results.json'))
v2 = json.load(open('/root/autodl-tmp/contrastive_trace_safety/artifacts/exp_r3_r1_32b_l63_bootstrap_v2/results.json'))

bonferroni_alpha = 0.0167
results = {
    "experiment": "R1-32B Layer 63 p-value unification: one-sided non-centered -> null-centered two-sided",
    "model": "DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B",
    "layer": 63,
    "n_bootstrap": 1000,
    "bonferroni_alpha": bonferroni_alpha,
    "method_old": "one-sided non-centered bootstrap (v1)",
    "method_new": "null-centered two-sided: bd_null = bd - mean(bd), p = mean(|bd_null| >= |obs|) (v2)",
    "comparison": {}
}

for w in ['W1','W3','W5','W10','W15']:
    w_data = {"window": int(w[1:])}
    for m in ['balanced_accuracy','precision','precp_fpr']:
        v1_b = v1['layer63_results'][w]['bootstrap'][m]
        v2_b = v2['layer63_results'][w]['bootstrap'][m]
        w_data[m] = {
            "observed_diff": v2_b['observed_diff'],
            "ci_95": v2_b['diff_ci95'],
            "p_value_old_onesided": v1_b['p_value'],
            "p_value_new_nullcentered": v2_b['p_value'],
            "significant_bonferroni_old": v1_b['p_value'] < bonferroni_alpha,
            "significant_bonferroni_new": v2_b['p_value'] < bonferroni_alpha,
            "significance_changed": (v1_b['p_value'] < bonferroni_alpha) != (v2_b['p_value'] < bonferroni_alpha)
        }
    results["comparison"][w] = w_data

# Summary
sig_old = []
sig_new = []
changed = []
for w in ['W1','W3','W5','W10','W15']:
    for m in ['balanced_accuracy','precision','precp_fpr']:
        entry = results["comparison"][w][m]
        key = f"{w}_{m}"
        if entry["significant_bonferroni_old"]:
            sig_old.append(key)
        if entry["significant_bonferroni_new"]:
            sig_new.append(key)
        if entry["significance_changed"]:
            changed.append(key)

results["summary"] = {
    "n_significant_old": len(sig_old),
    "n_significant_new": len(sig_new),
    "significant_old": sig_old,
    "significant_new": sig_new,
    "significance_changed": changed
}

outdir = '/root/autodl-tmp/contrastive_trace_safety/artifacts/exp_r3_r1_32b_l63_pvalue_unified'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
with open(f'{outdir}/results.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
print("Task A done.")
print(json.dumps(results["summary"], indent=2))
